# TripAdvisor Content API

The Tripadvisor Content API provides developers with access to extensive travel data including locations, reviews, photos, and ratings.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tripadvisor-content-api/.

## Actions

- **Get Location Photos** (read-only): Fetch high-quality recent photos for a specific location.
- **Search Locations** (read-only): Search for locations matching a query string.
